terravista.config.title: TerraVista
terravista.message.singleplayer_required: TerraVista: current-world import requires a singleplayer world.
terravista.message.region_missing: TerraVista: the current dimension has no accessible region directory.
terravista.config.general.workerCount.to: TerraVista background tasks and Sodium builders share this thread budget.
terravista.config.general.viewDistance.t: In chunks, from 8 to 8192 in steps of 8; the effective range is never below the vanilla distance.
Enter a whole number of chunks, return to settings and apply to save.
Seven levels, default level 3. Move right for more detail and resource use.
terravista.config.general.fogStyle.toolt: Disable normal environmental fog, follow world fog automatically, or customise density and distance. Dense medium and status-effect fog remains.
terravista.config.general.fogStrength.to: Opacity reached at the selected fog distance. 0% adds no ordinary fog; 100% fully obscures terrain at that distance.
terravista.config.general.fogReach.toolt: In chunks. Fog starts at 35% of this distance and reaches the selected strength at this distance.
terravista.config.general.ambientOcclusi: Controls distant shading detail; Auto selects quality for the window size.
terravista.config.distanceRange: Enter %s–%s chunks, at least the vanilla distance.
terravista.config.distanceApplyHint: Confirm, then Apply in settings to save.
terravista.message.log_unavailable: Log file unavailable; details were sent to standard error.
terravista.message.session_required: TerraVista: no world session is available.
Import existing chunks in the current singleplayer dimension.
terravista.config.general.importSave.too: Select a save folder containing level.dat to import all dimensions into the current world’s TerraVista data.
terravista.message.import_session_change: TerraVista: the world session changed; select the save again.
terravista.message.import_discovering: TerraVista: discovering save dimensions; please wait.
terravista.message.import_dimension_miss: TerraVista: dimension %s is unavailable in this environment and was not imported.
terravista.message.import_busy: TerraVista: dimension %s already has an import job; no duplicate was started.
terravista.config.general.foliageStyle.t: Dense fills leaf gaps. Natural uses filtered cutouts and removes hidden internal faces. Detailed keeps fine gaps and internal faces. Applying rebuilds distant terrain.
terravista.config.general.biomeBlendRadi: Blend neighbouring biome colours when rebuilding terrain. Zero disables blending.
terravista.config.general.biomeBlendScop: Choose which terrain receives blended biome colours.
terravista.config.general.worldCurvature: Apply the same curvature to vanilla chunks and LOD terrain. Zero disables it; positive values bend downward and negative values upward. Applying reloads resources.
Low favours smooth frames; high fills distant terrain faster. Adjusts model baking, root loading and build request budgets immediately without changing terrain detail.
Open the current instance’s tv/lod folder.
